correctness.rationale: The assigned maximum is correct as a direct consequence of known extremal A_k and its exact weak-zigzag SAS characterization: a length k+1 word is absent from k alternating permutation arches exactly if each transition forces the next block, i.e. x0>=x1<=x2>=..., including ties. Reflecting odd positions y_i=sigma−1−x_i converts each inequality to y_i+y_{i+1}>=sigma−1. Appending the universal threshold vertex sigma−1 gives a length k+1 graph walk, so its count is OEIS A050447 row sigma−1,column k+1. Kosche et al. Proposition 3.14 independently proves A_k maximizes SAS over words at fixed universality index. Independent exhaustive direct subsequence checks for sigma=2..5, k=1..4 matched the weak-zigzag/graph recurrence and tabulated values. Bounded scans are not proof of global extremality; that assertion is already established in the cited 2021 primary theorem.

originality.rationale: FAIL: The central two mathematical facts that determine the alleged new exact maximum were already proved by Kosche–Koß–Manea–Siemer: Proposition 3.14 gives the global maximum at A_k, and the opening of their Proposition 3.10 proof explicitly CHARACTERIZES every SAS(A_k) as the identical alternating weak inequalities. They further provide endpoint prefix-sum recurrences in the proof of Proposition 3.14. Separately OEIS A050447 (pre-October 2026, updated March 15 2026) already explicitly describes the same reversed-prefix-sum operator and threshold-graph walk matrix. The asserted all-(sigma,k) values therefore follow by a direct combinatorial reindexing of a known full characterization and an existing table. Absence of a verbatim SAS label in OEIS does not make this mathematical count independent prior work; claim-vs-prior implication is decisive.
residual_risks: The OEIS page does not explicitly mention shortest absent subsequences: originality rejection is based on direct logical implication of published complete weak-zigzag characterization and exact preexisting matrix, not a verbatim table citation.
It is possible to view the literature bridge as an expository connection; it does not establish a new independent maximum under the stated bar.
A previously published Resultary fixed-word-length binary Fibonacci extremum is a different quantification; it is not itself the decisive general covering result.
